description: This Java class 'FormWidgetArtifactInfo' models metadata about form widgets in the OFBiz framework, including their relationships to entities, services, parent forms, and controller requests. It provides methods to populate and retrieve this metadata, supporting artifact analysis and documentation.

classes.name: FormWidgetArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents metadata and relationships of a form widget in OFBiz, including its associated entities, services, parent form, and related controller requests. Provides methods to populate and access this information for artifact analysis.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates the form's related entities, services, parent form, and controller requests by analyzing its model form.

methods.name: populateFormExtended
methods.description: Sets the parent form this form extends, if any, and updates reverse references.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity artifacts used in the form based on a set of entity names.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service artifacts used in the form based on a set of service names.

methods.name: populateLinkedRequests
methods.description: Adds controller requests linked to this form based on request location set.

methods.name: populateTargetedRequests
methods.description: Adds controller requests targeted by this form based on request location set.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns a human-readable name for the form, including its location.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type 'Form Widget'.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the artifact type ID for form widgets.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns a unique identifier for the form based on location and name.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Resolves and returns the URL location of the form.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on form name and location.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the string representation.

methods.name: getEntitiesUsedInForm
methods.description: Returns the set of entity artifacts used in this form.

methods.name: getServicesUsedInForm
methods.description: Returns the set of service artifacts used in this form.

methods.name: getFormThisFormExtends
methods.description: Returns the parent form this form extends.

methods.name: getFormsExtendingThisForm
methods.description: Returns forms that extend this form.

methods.name: getScreensIncludingThisForm
methods.description: Returns screens that include this form.

methods.name: getRequestsLinkedToInForm
methods.description: Returns controller requests linked to this form.

methods.name: getRequestsTargetedByForm
methods.description: Returns controller requests targeted by this form.
